admitted_abi_versions.evidence: tools/native-abi/probe.generated.c compiled against this version's canonical headers; every bound prototype, struct size, alignment, field offset and field size in this manifest verified by the C compiler, and every by-value aggregate verified at run time through tools/native-abi/valueprobe.generated.c.

by_value_aggregate_rule.rule: A by-value aggregate parameter is bound only when its size is at most 16 bytes, so the System V AMD64 ABI passes it in registers rather than in memory. Each of its eightbytes is then passed as one scalar argument of the same class: an INTEGER eightbyte as an integer of its width (or as :pointer when the eightbyte is exactly one pointer field), and an SSE eightbyte as a C double, or a C float for a trailing four-byte one -- which is the register half the ABI gives a lone float argument. Those scalars occupy exactly the registers the aggregate itself would occupy, because the ABI assigns integer and SSE arguments from two independent sequences of registers. An aggregate larger than 16 bytes is MEMORY class, is refused by the generator, and its route is either shimmed or left unbound and reported as blocked.
by_value_aggregate_rule.why: CFFI cannot pass a structure by value without cffi-libffi, and cffi-libffi requires libffi headers and a C compiler at load time, which a released CNA-Lisp must not. Flattening is not a guess: tools/native-abi/valueprobe.generated.c declares each admitted aggregate with its real by-value prototype, and the run-time test calls it through the flattened shape and compares the bytes that arrived. See docs/native-abi.md.

shim_policy: A shim exists only for a route the generator has *proved* it cannot bind, it does nothing but reconstruct an aggregate and call through a caller-supplied function pointer, and it is never linked against CNA -- so it cannot drift from the library it forwards to. It is not shipped prebuilt: CNA_LISP_SHIM names it when a maintainer has built it, and the members that need it refuse with an actionable condition when it is absent.

shimmed_routes.name: cna_graphics_device_set_viewport
shimmed_routes.reason: Takes CNA_Viewport (24 bytes) by value. The System V AMD64 ABI classifies it MEMORY, and CFFI cannot pass a MEMORY-class aggregate without cffi-libffi, which a released CNA-Lisp must not require. The generator proves that refusal, and then emits the smallest thing that gets past it: a wrapper that takes the aggregate by pointer and the real route by function pointer, and does nothing but the one ABI transition. It is private, optional, never the public API, and the binding works without it in every other respect.
shimmed_routes.generator_proof: CNA_Viewport is 24 bytes: the System V AMD64 ABI classifies it MEMORY, which CFFI cannot express without cffi-libffi. Route left unbound.

shimmed_routes.name: cna_effect_matrices_set_world
shimmed_routes.reason: Takes CNA_Matrix (64 bytes) by value. The System V AMD64 ABI classifies it MEMORY, so it travels on the stack and no sequence of scalar arguments occupies the same place; CFFI cannot express that without cffi-libffi, which a released CNA-Lisp must not require. The generator proves that refusal, and then emits the smallest thing that gets past it: a wrapper that takes the aggregate by pointer and the real route by function pointer, and does nothing but the one ABI transition. It is private, optional and never the public API. This is BasicEffect's World, View or Projection setter; the getters take CNA_Matrix* and need no shim, and every other member of the effect surface binds directly.
shimmed_routes.generator_proof: CNA_Matrix is 64 bytes: the System V AMD64 ABI classifies it MEMORY, which CFFI cannot express without cffi-libffi. Route left unbound.

touches.reason: CNA's own tools/c-api/abi_baseline.json records CNA_TouchState's scalar fields and its total size of 272 bytes, but not the eight-element array of CNA_TouchLocation that accounts for the remaining 256. The offset and size here are asserted against the real compiler in the generated probe, which is the stronger of the two checks; nothing is taken on trust.
